messages:
joan: Flag  Asterly active calls down ~52% last 72h after onboarding completed. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/asterly (big drop on /chat and /embeddings).

ryan: Triage note  no SSO change. Runbook shows a default rate-limit policy applied during handoff on 2025-06-01. Suspect throttling.

meera: Customer PM says "flows are silently failing; users get slow retries then errors". She's on the thread.

cal: Logs show a large number of 429s from their org id starting 2025-06-02T04:10Z. I'll attach a short extract to the shared folder.

joan: Immediate plays: 1) Lift the org policy to restore normal limits for 48h. 2) Offer a 7-day burst pool to cover peak indexing. 3) Exec sync with Asterly procurement+PM within 24hrs to avoid them evaluating other vendors.

ryan: I can lift the policy now and watch error rates. Need ops approval to change quota.

meera: I'll draft a customer note explaining the mitigation and offer a credit for the outage window.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20250602-ASTERLY-RATE created for elevated 429s. PD notified.

cal: After policy lift, I'll run a quick canary and measure P95/P99. Sharing numbers back in 30m.

joan: Owners: @ryan  policy change (owner). @cal  canary & metrics. @meera  customer comms + credits. Meet to prep exec slides in 2h.

meera: CSV of affected seats uploaded. Will include a simple ROI slide for the exec sync.
